5. The trial Court by its judgment and decree dated 23.04.2006 decreed the suit in preliminary form giving saham to the plaintiff to the extent of 5 (five) decimals land from the scheduled land, i.e. from the two RS Plots being Nos.2864 and 2861 of RS Khatian Nos.120 and 48 respectively and also gave separate saham to the contesting defendants to the extent of 6(six) decimals land. 

 10. From the plaint, it appears that the plaintiff has made categorical assertion therein that though defendant No.9 sold 21/2 gonads land (equivalent to 5 decimals) to him by registered kabala dated 11.02.1980 out of RS Plot No.2864 of RS Khatian No.120 and RS Plot No.2861 of RS Khatian No.48, gave possession of the transferred land in RS Plot No.2684 only, as the entire land of RS Plot No.2861 "was found to have been given in possession of other purchasers" and the plaintiff has been in possession of said 5(five) decimals of land in RS Plot No.2864. The appellate Court, being the last Court of fact on consideration of the evidence on record and the admitted case of the parties, found that the total area of land in RS Plot No.2864 is 26 decimals, out of that, though the defendant No.9 sold 21/2 gonads land to the plaintiff by registered kabala dated 11.02.1980, 20 decimals land of Plot No.2864 along with the entire land of RS Plot No.2861 was acquired by defendant No.10. After acquisition only 6(six) decimals remained in RS Plot No.2864, out of this, the plaintiff claimed 5(five) decimals land and defendant No.1 claimed only 1(one) decimal land. The appellate Court further found that DWI Daulatur Rahman Chowdhury in his cross-examination clearly admitted the said fact. The appellate Court concluded that the plaintiff is in possession of his purchased 5(five) decimals land amicably and accordingly, allowed the appeal giving saham to him of 5(five) decimals land from RS Plot No.2864 and also gave saham to the contesting defendants to the extent of 1(one) decimal from Plot No.2864 +6(six) decimals of their purchased land. The High Court Division while maintaining the decision of the appellate Court noticed that defendant No.1 examined as DW 1 admitted that “২৮৬৪ দাগের আমাদের খরিদা জমির উত্তর প্রান্তে অবস্থিত। আর.এস নির্মাণ করিয়া তাহার অংশ বাদী দেওয়াল নির্মাণ করেন।” It further appears that the trial Court also gave finding that the plaintiff has been able to prove his possession in the suit land and that finding of possession obviously can be related to his possession in Plot No.2864, as the plaintiff never claimed that he got possession in Plot No.2861, it gave saham from two plots when admittedly, there is no land of the transferor (defendant No.9) in Plot No.2861.
